title: The Destroyer Challenge
wikitext:
{{Quest infobox | name = The Destroyer Challenge | campaign = Eye of the North | region = Far Shiverpeaks | type = Secondary | given by = [[High Priest Alkar]] | given at = [[Battledepths]]
or [[Central Transfer Chamber]] | preceded by = [[Destructive Research]] }} Alkar will give you an item which you are to use in the presence of a Destroyer. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Use [[Alkar's Concoction|Alkar's concoction]] against the Destroyers to test its effectiveness. * See [[High Priest Alkar]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 150 [[Dwarf reputation points]] * {{skill icon|Alkar's Alchemical Acid}} * [[Armor of Salvation]] ==Walkthrough== Find a [[Destroyer]] and activate the item given to you. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''High Priest Alkar''' :''Come, see the fruits of my labor! I've developed a concoction that should be of value when used against the Destroyers. Unfortunately, its effectiveness is in theory only, as I have not '''tested''' it against the real thing. I need you to do something for me. Whilst in the presence of a Destroyer, throw this '''vial''' to shatter the glass. When air hits the liquid it will create a gas, which should corrode the Destroyer's hide and cause it significant pain. You know, give them a '''taste''' of their own medicine! It should work... but if it doesn't I'll use your pay to finance a nice funeral service instead. How does that sound?'' {{offer dialog |accept = I'll take the Destroyer challenge. |decline = Four out of five adventurers agree this test is dangerous to their health. |ask = Take this '''vial''' of my concoction and use it when in close range of a '''Destroyer'''. Let me know the results. |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''High Priest Alkar''' :''Fantastic! Did you blindfold the Destroyers before dousing them with my secret formula? Ah, never mind. Now that we know it works, I'll give you this concentrated version I just finished. Don't forget to equip yourself before hunting Destroyers. Have fun!'' ==Notes== *[[Glint's Challenge]], [[G.O.L.E.M.]], and [[A Time For Heroes]] all have an easily accessed abundance of Destroyers that can be used to complete this quest.
